title: Ashbury Rewards Co-Brand Card Benefit Guide: Elite Bonus Card Add-On
content:
## Benefit

Cardmembers in active use of an Ashbury Rewards co-brand card earn a card add-on on the elite bonus of a completed stay. The card add-on is ten points for a member whose linked co-brand card is the Ashbury Rewards Premier card and whose account shows at least six co-brand card points transactions posted in the twelve months before the handling date, five points for a member whose linked card is the Ashbury Rewards card with at least six such transactions, and nothing for any other member. The add-on is added, in percentage points, to the elite bonus percentage of the member's tier. The elite bonus percentage with its add-ons is never more than 100 percent.

The twelve months before the handling date are the transactions posted after the same day number twelve months earlier, up to and including the handling date. The transactions counted are the co-brand card points the card issuer posts with each statement.

## Benefit table

| Linked card | Co-brand card points transactions in the twelve months | Card add-on |
|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Premier card | 6 or more | 10 percentage points |
| Ashbury Rewards card | 6 or more | 5 percentage points |
| Either card | 5 or fewer | None |
| No co-brand card | any | None |

## Illustration (hypothetical cardmembers)

A Gold Elite member whose elite bonus percentage is 25 percent holds the Ashbury Rewards Premier card with 7 statement postings in the window: the percentage carries a card add-on of 10 points, 35 percent. The same member with 5 postings carries no card add-on.
